research_question: Can transferring the local action response of pi0.5 improve SmolVLA under a held-out negative shoulder_lift perturbation?

response.scope_v1: initial observation and full 50-step action chunk
response.teacher_pairing: Use exactly the same teacher flow-noise tensor for the reference and perturbed observation within each response pair.
response.aggregation: Mean teacher response over the fixed teacher response noise seeds.
response.teacher_action_space: postprocessed physical action space: 5 arm joint targets in radians plus normalized gripper
response.teacher_response_target: R_T(o,delta) = mean_z[A_T(o_delta,z) - A_T(o_ref,z)], using identical teacher noise z within each pair

distillation_split.note: These variations may have appeared in the original base training dataset, but are the only variations used to construct the new response-distillation supervision.

primary_analysis.paired_unit: same variation_id x student policy noise_seed

methodological_constraints: Do not use -5deg observations or outcomes to construct the distillation targets.
Do not use evaluation variations v05-v19 to construct response supervision.
Use the same student training update budget for matched controls.
Freeze implementation, lambda, training steps, and checkpoints before running the evaluation split.
Lambda may be chosen using training-only response-loss scale diagnostics, but never using evaluation rollout success.
The proof-of-concept response-target KD is not claimed to be the final exact pairwise LPRD objective.

poc_training_formulation.name: response_target_kd
poc_training_formulation.continued_training_control: Continue training from the same SmolVLA checkpoint for the same update budget without teacher response targets.
poc_training_formulation.target_clipping: Clip synthesized physical action targets only to the valid actuator range and record every clipped value.
poc_training_formulation.exact_pairwise_lprd_loss: Deferred until this proof-of-concept establishes that teacher local response contains useful transferable signal.
